counting_rule: 13 deduplicated work packages, not 13 missing production modules or 13 extra PRs. GL IDs overlap these packages; development classes are not release completion percentages.

remaining_packages.title: Historical EIP-7702 skipped-authorization warming
remaining_packages.done_when: Fix and independently regress authority warming before nonce/code rejection; paid gas 48605 versus 46105 and post-root must agree at Osaka, while preserving all Amsterdam cases.

remaining_packages.kind: missing native test infrastructure and qualification
remaining_packages.title: Native Osaka/Amsterdam fixtures and independent envelope corpus
remaining_packages.done_when: Register coherent native fork contexts, pin selected official fixtures and expected counts, fail unsupported/missing required cases, and extend independent signed coverage beyond 32 type-2 and 10 type-4 cases to legacy/type-1/blob boundaries.

remaining_packages.title: Application and GAS/reservoir compatibility
remaining_packages.done_when: Run real wallet/router/delegation/failure-handler patterns, low forwarded execution with funded reservoir, nested refill/revert and side-effect/fee invariants; evaluate the selected model without silently adopting open alternatives.

remaining_packages.title: Outer limits and complete API/historical fixtures
remaining_packages.done_when: Exercise correctly bound cap/floor/state-budget negative payloads in Node and memory backends, plus official call/estimate/access/simulate/trace and historical/override matrices. Six direct-transition cap controls are not six proven acceptance bugs; the prior oversized fixture did not reach receiver validation.

remaining_packages.title: Integrate the three Lighthouse reviews and compatible client artifact
remaining_packages.done_when: Review/merge or otherwise publish a compatible candidate carrying CL PRs 1/2/3, pin it against EL 5fbc7c13, rerun actual CL transition/BLS/request/slot component tests and complete builds, including payload/beacon slot binding, adopted signing domains, slashed-proposer exclusion and churn/weak-subjectivity fork boundaries. Existing 25-test candidate 44324117 is component evidence, not final live acceptance.

remaining_packages.kind: CL security/fork-choice qualification with conditional implementation
remaining_packages.title: Payload authentication and optimistic lifecycle
remaining_packages.done_when: Freeze the selected authentication format, isolate contents/claimed-hash/request binding and seen-cache negatives, then qualify FULL/EMPTY/PENDING, latestValidHash, late/missing envelopes, descendant invalidation, empty heads and restart/reorg. Open 5770/5820/5781/5818 are not all mandatory patches.

remaining_packages.title: Builder settlement exactly once
remaining_packages.done_when: Reproduce late-child/epoch-eviction/slashed/no-quorum/exit cases in actual selected CL and assert debits, credits, withdrawals and supply. Upstream issue 5754 is open; this audit demonstrates no local double-payment exploit.

remaining_packages.title: Progressive migration and real proof consumers
remaining_packages.done_when: Qualify nonzero fork-state migration, stable generalized indices, independent proof/root vectors, runtime sizes/limits and actual light-client consumers. Code already generates progressive proofs; the unused unsupported-error comment is not a missing implementation.

remaining_packages.title: Partial columns, version/group IDs and custody recovery
remaining_packages.done_when: Cross real CL peers at the selected Gloas boundary with group/version, bitmap and cell ordering under loss/duplication/reconnect; compose actual EL custody/cell methods. Existing native eth/72 and progressive CL data types are retained evidence.

remaining_packages.title: Full independent multiclient and external-builder devnet
remaining_packages.done_when: Use current native EL plus a compatible independent EL, actual Lighthouse plus independent CL, and external builder across a coordinated fork with contracts/blobs. Preserve exact revisions, actual Engine/P2P wire, independent commitments and rejection controls.

remaining_packages.title: Long cold sync, retention, reorg and durable recovery
remaining_packages.done_when: Run native and independent process cold sync, missed-window/orphan history, pruning/retention edges, restart/reorg and storage-failure campaigns. Existing small encrypted/native recovery scenarios are not erased and do not establish the full campaign.

remaining_packages.title: Measured CPU/memory/disk/latency and queue budgets
remaining_packages.done_when: Set workload/hardware/target schedules and thresholds, then measure valid/adversarial execution/state/blob mixes, historical serving, cancellation and durable storage/queue pressure. CPSB rationale and successful block production are not measured ETH2030 operating headroom.

remaining_packages.title: Final compatible target, scope, artifact manifest and runbooks
remaining_packages.done_when: Record final compatible EL/CL/Engine/devp2p/API/fixture/runtime/network inputs, resolve the declared gas/auth/schema choices, retain all unknowns, then publish qualified artifacts and upgrade/recovery procedure after gates pass. Merging the development model closes PR integration, not external protocol adoption.
